title_hi: रिवार्ड लर्निंग: studies क्या measure करती हैं?
unique_angle: Reward-learning studies combine observed choices and outcomes with model-inferred values and prediction errors; model-based fMRI adds an indirect BOLD comparison, so a fitted learning-rate parameter is not automatically dopamine, intelligence, or a universal learning score.
evidence_class: peer-reviewed computational-neuroscience reviews + methodological model-interpretation study + neuroimaging meta-analysis
